Fixed clock: none stated, and none is needed - no criterion or prompt reads relative dates or 'today'; the only time facts are real-time 15 s live windows (instruction.md:5, hireops_rules.md:117) and fixed historical seed timestamps. Network: public, CDN allowed (instruction.md:13, integration.md:12-13); no offline constraint required per SKILL delivery profile. Liveness probe (test.sh:42-57) accepts any HTTP response from /api/health or /, within 30 s (120x0.25 s), consistent with the stated health contract.

Polish: hro_pol_live_board/live_thread (draft, focus, open card, scroll preserved) <- instruction.md:5,7, rules:121-123, 158; hro_pol_earlier_place <- rules:145-147; hro_pol_failed_send (explanation, text kept; note draft survives reload) <- rules:106, 139-140; hro_pol_session_resume (re-sign-in prompt, draft survives, other user sees none, note drafts per person) <- instruction.md:7, rules:106, 170-175. Visual likert rows judge a desktop workspace <- instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters'; candidate view included in colour row is a required view (instruction.md:11). No criterion grades theme switching, mobile layout, routes, labels or exact wording; prompts state 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording' (functional prompt.md:15). Sign-in is explicitly asked here (instruction.md:9,17), so the house-convention FP does not even arise.

RAW EVIDENCE: raw-evidence-index.json input_sha256 matches; all 6 listed artifacts' SHA256 recomputed and match. Its scripted golden run (uid 65534, real restart) is consistent with the stated launch contract but is not a configured judge run; this row is a source-level coverage check and does not depend on missing Oracle/model scores.

ADVERSARIAL TRIES: (a) Conforming alternative that could fail: an app serving its UI only under a sub-path (e.g. /workspace) with 404 at '/'. Judges open http://localhost:3000; the brief says only 'serve the UI ... from that one process' and 'routes ... your call' (instruction.md:13). However prompts direct discovery by intent and the probe accepts any HTTP status, and a root that does not lead to the product is not a reasonable reading of 'serve the UI' for a desktop workspace at port 3000 - Note only, P3. (b) Hiring manager adding a candidate refused (hro_mgr_early_refused) - asked implicitly via role table rules:16-17 and 'A recruiter adds a candidate' rules:31; blank job title refused - 'A job has a title' rules:27. Both are fair readings; Note only. (c) Broken app that could pass this row's concern: none - the row is about public statement of graded demands; no graded demand was found without a public source.
